off_slice_note: muscle not on the slice shown: value measured over the whole volume.
not_on_diagram_note: segmented muscle, not drawn on the anatomical diagram.
ff_intro: Biomarker of structural damage. Proportion of fat signal in muscle, measured with quantitative Dixon MRI: it maps the chronic replacement of muscle fibres by adipose tissue and integrates the cumulative history of degeneration. Complementary to T2.
t2_intro: Biomarker of disease activity. Transverse relaxation time of muscle water protons, sensitive to membrane integrity, oedema and necrosis. Sensitive but non-specific: it reflects disease activity, not aetiology, and rises before fat replacement. Abnormality threshold: 39 ms (healthy volunteers; Carlier et al., J Inherit Metab Dis, 2015).
ff_scale_note: FF < 5 %: very low infiltration. 5 to 40 %: zone of clinical interest, graded. FF > 40 %: severe infiltration, muscle considered non-recoverable.
t2_scale_note: Grey (< 24 ms): measurement uncertainty, not interpretable. Blue (24 to 37 ms): normal range. Yellow (37 to 41 ms): caution zone around the threshold. Orange to red (> 41 ms): elevated value. Values above the 39 ms threshold in bold.
mean_volumetric_note: Volumetric mean per muscle (all acquired slices), shown on the middle slice.
evolution_note_ff: Change in FF since the previous exam, in points.
evolution_note_t2: Change in T2 since the previous exam, in ms.
evolution_color_note: Color indicates the biomarker variation relative to the previous exam.
comment_auto_note: Automatically generated comment from per-muscle T2 values.
segmentation_note: Muscle outlines are from automatic segmentation.
no_antecedent_message: First recorded exam: no prior data available for this sequence.
volume_aggregate_note: aggregated value over the entire muscle volume, representative of the overall muscle status.
